body.description: SAL, a teenage boy, young scavenger hero of a post-collapse Texas: messy brown hair under a worn leather cap with brass goggles pushed up on the brow, red bandana at the neck, scuffed tan work jacket with a shearling collar, denim trousers with patched knee pads, worn brown boots, a small tool pouch on the belt, determined hopeful face
body.style_description: classic tactics RPG unit sprite: slender realistic proportions about 6 heads tall, muted watercolour-like earth palette, soft dithered shading, thin dark brown outline, mature serious tone, delicate detail
